Shows what was drawn into the back buffer in the window. A program draws a complete picture into the back buffer after `SetBuffer BackBuffer()` and calls Flip once per frame, which keeps the picture free of flicker. The frame rate of the program follows the display when `vwait` is on.

```blitzbasic
;media gif display/flip.gif 40 20
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local x = 0
While x < 160
	Cls
	Color 255, 160, 0
	Oval x * 2, 100, 40, 40, 1
	Color 255, 255, 255
	Text 10, 10, "Frame " + x
	Flip
	x = x + 4
Wend
```

![Flip](media/display/flip.gif)
@param vwait  1 waits for the display to be ready before flipping, which avoids tearing. 0 does not wait and may tear. 2 keeps the picture free of tearing but never makes the program wait (see below). Defaults to 1.
@gap Without a graphics window nothing happens.
`Flip 2` is an extension, see [Presentation sync](Presentation-Sync).
